title: Container Bookings: Amount of a Late VGM Entry
content:
This page fixes the amount written on a Container Bookings late VGM entry.

## Rule

A VGM counts as late where the booking record places its receipt at a moment after the booking's VGM cut-off; one received at or before the cut-off leads to no entry. A late VGM that stays within the free allowance is entered at 0.00. Otherwise its full fee is the product's late VGM rate per container multiplied by the containers charged, with a single rounding to two decimal places applied to the finished figure.

## Worked examples (hypothetical rate of 88.40 per container)

| Receipt against cut-off | Within allowance | Containers charged | Entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 minutes early | not relevant | 4 | none |
| exactly at the cut-off | not relevant | 4 | none |
| 2 hours late | yes | 4 | 0.00 |
| 2 hours late | no | 4 | 353.60 |
| 2 hours late | no | 0 | 0.00 |

The rate and times are invented; they illustrate the rule and are not product values.
